## Description

An olive-brown cryptophyte (32–61 µm), oval with a rostrum, two unequal flagella, two chloroplasts
with pyrenoids and starch, and a gullet lined with ejectosomes: disturbed, it fires them and jumps
away. Prey of ciliates, and source of the kleptoplasts of *Mesodinium*.

## Not implemented yet

- Ejectosome discharge (escape jump) is not modelled.
- Phycoerythrin colour is not distinguished from chlorophyll in stains or fluorescence.

## Unique and shared mechanics

Its chloroplasts become [kleptoplasts](../../mechanics/symbioses.md) in *Mesodinium rubrum*.
